title: Nova
subtitle: The radiant cut does what it was made for — it takes color and multiplies it. Fancy Yellow doesn't sit quietly in a setting. It radiates.
description: The yellow gold bezel is not decoration but amplification — it pulls the colour of the Fancy Yellow centre down into the metal until the whole ring seems carved from a single warm light. Then the white diamond halo shifts the register, wrapping that deep warmth in crisp, cool brilliance so the two temperatures play against each other. The radiant cut at the centre does what it was made for: it takes the colour and multiplies it, throwing yellow outward rather than holding it in. Warmth and clarity, set in one ring.
inquirySubject: Nova — The Fancy Yellow Ring ref. R09014
